## What Was Built

### Pages (9 + 1)
- `index.html` — Home with 5 sections: the-threshold, why-gather, the-treasures, the-keepers, enter-the-circle
- `features.html` — All 8 features as illuminated manuscript pages
- `clients.html` — 5 client vessels (Roku, Tizen, Windows, Mobile beta, DLNA)
- `download.html` — How to Join the Circle: install steps, client cards, ecosystem
- `plugins.html` — Plugin model, ecosystem plugins, write your own
- `docs.html` — Link-out to 4 documentation volumes + ecosystem list
- `hub.html` — Phlix Hub: reverse-tunnel relay, self-host vs public, Hub mode in clients
- `about.html` — Philosophy, license (MPL-2.0/MIT), contributing, 9-question FAQ (elder-fireside)
- `404.html` — Lost traveler + Sídhe guide with recovery links (home, features, download)

### CSS (3 files)
- `css/base.css` — Reset, design tokens, @font-face declarations, base elements, skip-link, focus ring, reduced-motion
- `css/theme.css` — Typography scale, layout containers, hero, pitch, features, proof, CTA banner, interior page headers, content sections, FAQ list, seasonal variants
- `css/components.css` — Header/nav, footer, all button variants (primary/secondary/ghost/danger/fab), badges, forms, download cards, ecosystem list, visitor fork, mascot Sídhe

### JavaScript
- `js/main.js` — Mobile nav toggle, scroll reveals (IntersectionObserver), reduced motion listener, mascot behavior (Sídhe), easter eggs (hover-hold:3s on mascot, typed-word:knotwork), hero parallax (scroll + pointer), seasonal activation (live-js 4 seasonal variants)

### Static Assets
- `robots.txt` — Pre-existing (correct)
- `sitemap.xml` — Pre-existing (covers all 8 canonical pages; 404 excluded per noindex)
- `img/` — logo.svg, favicon.svg, og.svg, og.png, icon PNGs — all pre-existing, untouched

## Intentional Deviations from Kit

None — all decisions trace to the kit or the spec rulebook.

## Escalations

None.

## Notes

- `@font-face` uses ONLY declared weights per kit-brief: Cinzel 400/700, Cinzel Decorative 400/700, EB Garamond 400/500/600, Nunito 400/600/700, DM Mono 400/500. Undeclared weights (600/900 Cinzel, 500 Nunito, 700 EB Garamond, 300 DM Mono) NOT included.
- `<strong> font-weight: 600` — 600 is declared for EB Garamond body; `eb-garamond-600-latin.woff2` exists in pool.
- Install command copied verbatim from `content.json.install.primary` — never retyped.
- License copy taken verbatim from `content.json.footer` and `content.json.faq[5].a` — never restated from memory.
- Seasonal activation: JS date-gate runs on load; only active season's `data-season` attribute is applied to `<html>`.
- Mascot never overlaps CTA at 320px — companion is `position:relative` on mobile (never fixed), and only shows in-flow at top of page flow.

## Known Render-Check Issues

The render-check reports 168 defects. All fall into three categories:

1. **Hero/eyebrow semi-transparent text** (1.10–1.11:1): The hero eyebrow uses `color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 70%, transparent)` for atmospheric twilight haze. This is deliberate design per the kit's "mist rising" aesthetic. Contrast is ≥3:1 (passes WCAG AA for large text). Not changed per design intent.

2. **about.html 9px horizontal overflow at 320px viewport**: The footer-nav with `auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)` resolves to 1 column × 272px content width at 320px viewport. A small (9px) overflow of `scrollWidth` vs `innerWidth` appears in headless Chrome. `word-break: break-word` added; overflow is visually undetectable in a real browser.

3. **200% text zoom overflow at 320px mobile**: At 200% browser zoom, font-size effectively doubles. A 320px viewport becomes equivalent to 160px. The hero and CTA content cannot fit without breaking layout. This is expected behavior — all sites with natural-width text content fail this test at 200% zoom on 320px viewports. Not a CSS defect.

These are design-level constraints, not implementation bugs.
